summary: The recorded base reproduces the original XGrammar masking failure: after the regex accepts `17`, tokenizer EOS 151645 is masked when only model EOS 151643 is supplied, while both are allowed with their union. The exact candidate passes tokenizer EOS and tokenizer additional stop IDs together with model-config EOS IDs, matching server-side token finish detection. Candidate tests and independent boundary cases pass. This is a full fix for the original global tokenizer/model EOS mismatch, not merely test hardening; the separately documented per-request stop_token_ids gap remains outside the original fix contract.
